description: Data-only QA scenario manifest for the AlKhayal acceptance runner (scripts/run-acceptance-tests.ps1). Maps scenario IDs to exact xUnit FullyQualifiedName test selectors. This file contains no logic; later batches extend it by adding titles/tests to placeholder entries or appending new scenarios. Never edit an already-mapped scenario's tests without re-executing them. Batch F (2026-10-29, opencode-go/glm-5.3) filled the phase-4 purchasing range QA-056..QA-071, the phase-5 sales/printing/frontend ranges QA-072..QA-093, and the cross-module range QA-094..QA-100 with direct mappings, and appended justified gap scenarios QA-102..QA-115. Frontend-group scenarios carry "group": "frontend" with an empty tests array: the runner executes the single coarse frontend suite for them, and that pass is never counted as a business-transaction proof. Mapped entries from earlier batches were preserved verbatim (only placeholder entries with empty titles were replaced).
numberingCaveat: The repository has no committed canonical QA-001..QA-100 checklist. QA-001..QA-017 follow docs/qa/phase-1-coverage.md (QA-004/QA-005 are authoritative; the rest are marked inferred there). Batch 3 (2026-10-26) confirmed the phase/module ranges per the QA owner's explicit instruction and defined QA-018..QA-039; see docs/qa/phase-2-coverage.md. QA-040..QA-100 remain unmapped scaffold placeholders under the scaffoldRanges convention below; a later batch that owns the canonical list must replace or confirm them. Batch F note (2026-10-29): QA-056..QA-100 are now filled and mapped; earlier-batch mappings are unchanged. QA-102..QA-115 are justified unmapped gaps (manual-only, not-implemented, or automatable future work). The docs/qa/phase-4-coverage.md referenced by the interrupted Batch 4B test-file header was never created; docs/qa/coverage-matrix.md is the consolidated record. Batch F FQN correction (2026-10-29): phase 6/7 consolidated several test FILES (PurchasingPersistenceTests.cs, PurchasingTreasuryTests.cs, SupplierPaymentAllocationTests.cs, SupplierPaymentTreasuryTests.cs, SupplierAccountsTests.cs, PrintingApiTests.cs, LabelsApiTests.cs, SalesTreasuryApiTests.cs) into partial classes of AlKhayal.IntegrationTests.InventoryPersistenceTests and AlKhayal.IntegrationTests.TreasuryApiTests; all Batch F selectors now use the real compiled class names, verified against TRX test definitions.

statusSemantics.PASS: Every mapped test for the scenario was executed in this run and passed, and the manifest records no manual/browser/desktop/hardware remainder for the scenario.
statusSemantics.PARTIAL: Every mapped test for the scenario ran and passed, but the scenario carries an unexecuted manual remainder (browser-only native, desktop, or hardware portion). PARTIAL is never converted to PASS; the open remainder is reported in the record's manualRemainder and reason.
statusSemantics.FAIL: One or more mapped tests failed, or a mapped test did not appear in the run results (selector mismatch or discovery failure).
statusSemantics.SKIP: Mapped scenario that was outside the requested run scope and therefore not executed in this run.
statusSemantics.BLOCKED: The scenario could not be executed honestly: unmapped placeholder, no automated test mapping, missing tool (dotnet/node), or a build failure. BLOCKED is never converted to PASS.
